payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear methodology for measuring grammatical correctness through both automatic and manual evaluations, including the use of POS tagging and statistical language models.

claims.text: Grammatical correctness is evaluated by identifying POS tags for each sentence and checking for matching sequences of POS tags across the corpus.
The system uses a statistical language model based on n-grams to ensure grammatical correctness in generated speeches.
Manual evaluations indicated that grammatical correctness scored an average of 2.3 out of 3, confirming the effectiveness of the evaluation methods.
